basis: Tumour originates in the mediastinum, outside the specified axes; respiratory distress or venous compression alone does not establish organ invasion.
Predisposition to sympathetic neural tumours defines the concept; tumour phenotypes reported at 5% do not establish common additional organ damage.
Carcinoma originates in salivary glands, which belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Developmental regression, intellectual disability and epilepsy define the encephalopathy; supplied CHD2 definition overrides misleading synonyms.
Cerebellar dysfunction and gonadotropin deficiency define syndrome; scoliosis 3/3 and strabismus 1/3 support additional axes; small cohort.
Brain and renal malformations define syndrome; marrow hypocellularity/pancytopenia and pulmonary hypoplasia each 1/1 assessed; Peters anomaly omitted by cap; sparse data.
Benign lipomatous tumour originates in the conjunctiva.
Minimal-change nephrotic syndrome is an immune-mediated glomerular podocyte disorder; no common direct extrarenal damage established.
Definition specifies urothelial origin in prostatic ducts or prostatic urethra; the urethra belongs to the renal axis.
Progressive cerebellar degeneration defines disease; occasional diplopia does not establish direct ocular damage.
Neoplasm involves the pineal body, an endocrine gland within the brain; both sites are explicit in the definition and ancestry.
Neurodevelopmental impairment, spasticity and movement disorder define disease; isolated muscle findings do not establish common independent muscle damage.
Hepatic disease is explicit; cyanosis alone cannot identify cardiac, pulmonary or haematologic pathology.
Definition specifies nonsyndromic intellectual disability; no clinical evidence establishes a systemic metabolic disorder or other organ damage.
Intellectual disability, joint/skeletal defects and ear malformations define syndrome; renal hypoplasia 30-79%; tracheal anomalies 30-79% omitted by cap.
Allergic contact dermatitis ancestry establishes immune-mediated skin disease caused by sensitization to 2-HEMA.
Intellectual disability defines disease; pes planus reported in 3/4; incontinence does not establish urinary tract damage; testicular dysplasia is reproductive.
Varicella-zoster reactivation causes neural infection and radiculitis without the cutaneous eruption; no dermatologic damage is established.
Joubert brain malformation defines disease; retinopathy in 1/2 supports ocular involvement; isolated renal pelvis dilation in 1/2 does not establish damage.
Corneal abnormalities and anterior polar cataracts define an ocular disorder with visual impairment.
Skeletal dysplasia ancestry establishes primary bone involvement; no supplied evidence supports another axis.
Definition explicitly identifies a neurodevelopmental disorder of visual-spatial processing; this does not imply ocular disease.
Chondrodysplasia with epiphyseal stippling, short tibiae and metacarpal abnormalities is a primary skeletal disorder.
Lower motor-neuron degeneration defines SMA2; denervation causes skeletal muscle atrophy and weakness in essentially all; respiratory weakness alone adds no lung axis.
Peripartum dilated cardiomyopathy directly damages myocardium; dyspnoea and oedema reflect cardiac dysfunction rather than independent pulmonary damage.
